answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a unique lattice-site vertex derived from a jade-tagged hardware attestation, so duplicate registrations collapse onto one occupied trap site rather than a fresh meadow of phantom accounts. Sybil resistance then follows a Sisyphus-cooling analogue: repeated collusive re-registration is damped below the sub-Doppler recoil limit. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
